description: This file defines the class OptimizedPhpArrayDumper, which serializes a service container as a PHP array or serialized string for performance optimization in Drupal's dependency injection system.

classes.name: OptimizedPhpArrayDumper
classes.description: A class that dumps a service container as a serialized PHP array, optimized for performance and handling private services distinctly.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes the container as a PHP array or string.

methods.name: getArray
methods.description: Returns the container's definition as a PHP array.

methods.name: getAliases
methods.description: Retrieves container aliases as a PHP array.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Retrieves container parameters as a PHP array.

methods.name: getServiceDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves service definitions as a PHP array.

methods.name: prepareParameters
methods.description: Prepares parameters for dumping, escaping '%' characters.

methods.name: getServiceDefinition
methods.description: Converts a Definition object into a PHP array representing a service.

methods.name: dumpMethodCalls
methods.description: Serializes method calls of a service definition.

methods.name: dumpCollection
methods.description: Serializes a collection (array or object) into PHP array or object format.

methods.name: dumpCallable
methods.description: Serializes a callable into a PHP array format.

methods.name: getPrivateServiceCall
methods.description: Creates a lightweight object representing a private service.

methods.name: dumpValue
methods.description: Serializes a value, handling references, parameters, expressions, and collections.

methods.name: getReferenceCall
methods.description: Creates a representation for a service reference, handling private services.

methods.name: getServiceCall
methods.description: Creates a representation for a service reference.

methods.name: getParameterCall
methods.description: Creates a representation for a parameter reference.

methods.name: getServiceClosureCall
methods.description: Creates a representation for a service closure.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Creates a representation for an iterator argument.
